meta.name: schema-markup-generator
meta.description: Generate JSON-LD structured data markup for rich results in Google Search. Supports FAQ, HowTo, Article, Product, LocalBusiness, and multi-type schemas. Validates against Google requirements and provides implementation guidance. Use when asked to "add schema markup", "generate structured data", "JSON-LD", "rich snippets", "FAQ schema", "product markup", "add structured data to my page", "how to get rich snippets", or any structured data task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为网页生成结构化数据标记，提升搜索引擎展示效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Google搜索中展示更丰富的页面信息
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured data markup for better search engine display
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to display richer page information in Google search results

howto.what: 根据用户提供的页面类型或内容,生成JSON-LD结构化数据标记,支持FAQ、HowTo、Article、Product、LocalBusiness等;并检查是否符合Google要求,提供嵌入网页的方法。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加schema标记、生成结构化数据或获取富结果等,或提出任何结构化数据相关任务时触发。

howto.what_en: Generates JSON-LD structured data markup based on the user-provided page type or content, covering FAQ, HowTo, Article, Product, LocalBusiness, and more. It also validates the markup against Google requirements and provides guidance on embedding the code into a webpage.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add schema markup, generate structured data, or get rich snippets, or any structured-data-related request.

say_en.text: Generate JSON-LD markup for this FAQ page.
say_en.note: Claude will produce FAQPage schema code.

say_en.text: Create Product structured data with price and availability for my product page.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Product schema and note required properties.

say_en.text: Check if this JSON-LD meets Google's rich result requirements.
say_en.note: Claude will run the validation checklist and flag issues.
